question: Whom among the following Indian singers is known as ‘Gazal King’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jagjit Singh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jagjit Singh** is renowned as the '**Gazal King**' in India.
 
• He was a prominent Indian ghazal singer, composer, and musician.
 
• His work in the field of ghazals has earned him the title and widespread recognition across the globe.
 
• He has contributed significantly to the popularization of ghazals and has a vast discography that includes numerous hit albums.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jagjit Singh** was born on 8th February 1941 and passed away on 10th October 2011.
 
• He is credited with bringing the ghazal genre to a wider audience in India and around the world.
 
• He was awarded the **Padma Bhushan** by the Government of India in 2003 for his contribution to music.
 
• His collaboration with his wife, Chitra Singh, also a renowned ghazal singer, resulted in many memorable duets.
 
• Some of his famous ghazals include "Hothon Se Chhoo Lo Tum", "Tum Itna Jo Muskura Rahe Ho", and "Jhuki Jhuki Si Nazar".
